text: My husband suddenly can't speak properly and one side of his face is drooping.
rationale: Sudden speech difficulty and facial droop are stroke warning signs: call emergency services.

text: My 4 year old swallowed a lot of my grandmother's heart tablets about 20 minutes ago.
rationale: Possible poisoning/overdose in a young child needs emergency care immediately.

text: I've had a cough and now I'm coughing up a lot of bright red blood and I feel breathless.
rationale: Heavy haemoptysis with breathlessness is an emergency.

text: I am 8 months pregnant and I am bleeding heavily from the vagina and have severe belly pain.
rationale: Heavy bleeding with severe pain in late pregnancy suggests an obstetric emergency.

text: My father is 70, he fainted at home and now he is confused and says his heart is racing.
rationale: Collapse with new confusion and palpitations in an older man with heart disease needs emergency assessment.

text: I was stung by a bee and my lips and tongue are swelling, it is getting hard to breathe.
rationale: Swelling of lips/tongue with breathing difficulty after a sting suggests anaphylaxis.

text: Mere pitaji ko seene mein bahut dard hai aur paseena aa raha hai.
rationale: (Hinglish) Father with severe chest pain and sweating: possible heart attack.

text: He was hit by a bike and he is bleeding heavily from his leg and it won't stop.
rationale: Uncontrolled heavy bleeding is an emergency.

text: I feel hopeless and I swallowed a lot of tablets to end it, now I feel very sleepy.
rationale: Intentional overdose with suicidal intent and drowsiness: emergency and mental-health support.

text: My 2 month old baby has a fever of 38.5, is very sleepy and is feeding badly.
rationale: Fever in a baby under 3 months who is drowsy and not feeding needs emergency assessment.

text: I got the worst headache of my life all of a sudden, I feel sick and my neck is stiff.
rationale: Sudden thunderclap headache with neck stiffness and vomiting: possible bleed or meningitis.

text: I'm 24, I've had burning urine and fever for 3 days and now a pain in my right back with chills.
rationale: Urinary symptoms with fever and flank pain suggest a kidney infection: same-day assessment.

text: My 70 year old mother has diabetes and has been vomiting with loose motions for 2 days, she can't keep water down and her mouth is very dry.
rationale: Dehydration with inability to keep fluids in an older person with diabetes: same-day care.

text: I have severe pain in my lower right belly since last night, it hurts more when I move and I have a fever.
rationale: Right lower abdominal pain with fever is an appendicitis-type picture: same-day assessment.

text: I fell off my bike, my wrist looks bent and I can't use my hand, it is very painful.
rationale: Visible deformity after a fall suggests a fracture: needs same-day imaging.

text: I have chronic lung disease, a wheezy cough, and I get breathless after a few steps and my inhaler is not helping.
rationale: Worsening breathlessness not relieved by the usual inhaler in chronic lung disease needs same-day care (borderline emergency).

text: I cut my hand with a kitchen knife 3 hours ago, it is a deep gaping cut but the bleeding stopped with pressure.
rationale: A deep gaping wound needs closure within hours.

text: My 3 year old has had a fever of 39.5 for 3 days and is hardly drinking anything.
rationale: A young child with high fever and poor fluid intake needs same-day assessment.

text: I have not been able to pass urine at all since morning and my lower belly is swollen and painful.
rationale: Acute urinary retention needs same-day care.

text: I have had a sore throat for 4 days and now I can't swallow even my saliva and my voice sounds muffled.
rationale: Unable to swallow saliva with a muffled voice suggests a deep throat infection: same-day care (borderline emergency).

text: I spilled boiling water on my forearm, the burn is bigger than my palm, blistered and very painful.
rationale: A burn larger than the palm with blistering needs same-day assessment.

text: I'm 20 weeks pregnant with a fever of 38.6 and a dull pain in my back for 2 days.
rationale: Fever with back/flank pain in pregnancy raises concern for kidney infection: same-day care.

text: I have had a fever for 2 days and my neck feels stiff, maybe from sleeping badly. I am not confused and I can drink fine.
rationale: Fever with a stiff neck needs same-day assessment to exclude meningitis, even when otherwise well (borderline emergency).

text: I'm 30 and I've had a fever of 101 F for 3 days with body ache. I can breathe fine and I'm drinking well.
rationale: Fever lasting 3 days without warning signs: see a doctor within a few days.

text: I'm 45, a smoker, I've had a cough for 3 weeks and I have lost some weight.
rationale: A cough lasting weeks with weight loss needs a doctor's review (not an emergency).

text: I'm 26 and I've had burning when I pee and a frequent urge for 2 days, no fever, no back pain.
rationale: Uncomplicated urinary symptoms: doctor within 1-3 days.

text: My 6 year old has had ear pain for 2 days and a mild fever of 38, nothing coming out of the ear.
rationale: Child with earache and mild fever: doctor within a few days.

text: I've had a headache every day for 5 days, moderate, no weakness, no fever, no vomiting.
rationale: Persistent daily headache without red flags: see a doctor within a few days.

text: I've had lower back pain for 2 weeks since lifting something heavy. No leg weakness and no urinary problems.
rationale: Back pain not improving after 2 weeks: doctor review (no red flags).

text: I have had loose motions for 4 days with a mild fever, no blood, I'm drinking fine.
rationale: Diarrhoea lasting 4 days with fever: doctor within a few days.

text: I'm 68 with high blood pressure and I've felt dizzy when I stand up for the last 3 days. No fainting, no chest pain.
rationale: Recurrent dizziness in an older person on treatment for hypertension: doctor review within days.

text: I have a sore throat and a fever of 38.5 for 3 days, I'm 19, swallowing is fine and no breathing problem.
rationale: Sore throat with fever for 3 days: doctor within a few days.

text: My 80 year old father has heart disease and has had a mild cough and a low fever for 2 days, otherwise OK.
rationale: A mild respiratory illness in a frail older person with heart disease deserves review within days.

text: I have an itchy rash spreading over my chest for 4 days. No fever, I feel fine otherwise.
rationale: Spreading rash lasting days without red flags: doctor review within days.

text: I have a mild sore throat since yesterday, no fever, swallowing is fine.
rationale: Mild short sore throat: self-care.

text: I have a runny nose and sneezing for 2 days, mild, no fever.
rationale: Common cold symptoms: self-care.

text: I have a mild headache since this morning after sleeping badly, nothing else wrong.
rationale: Mild tension-type headache: self-care.

text: I got a small paper cut on my finger, it stopped bleeding and looks clean.
rationale: Trivial cut: self-care.

text: I had a bit of stomach upset after eating out, one loose stool, no fever and I'm drinking fine.
rationale: Mild short-lived stomach upset: self-care.

text: I twisted my ankle yesterday, it's a bit swollen and I'm walking with a limp, but I can put weight on it.
rationale: Mild sprain, bears weight, no deformity: self-care and review if not improving.

text: I have had a mild cough for 3 days, no fever and no breathing trouble.
rationale: Mild short cough: self-care.

text: I have a slight temperature of 99.5 F since this evening, I feel a little tired, nothing else.
rationale: Low-grade fever for hours without warning signs: self-care and monitor.

text: My thigh muscles ache after the gym yesterday, nothing else.
rationale: Post-exercise muscle ache: self-care.

text: I get mild heartburn after meals for a few days. No chest pain, no vomiting, no black stools.
rationale: Mild heartburn without alarm features: self-care.

text: I have an itchy red bump from an insect bite on my arm, no swelling elsewhere and no trouble breathing.
rationale: Local insect bite reaction: self-care.

text: I have no chest pain and no breathing problems, just a mild headache since this morning.
rationale: Red-flag words are negated; a mild headache is self-care. Tests that denials do not trigger alarms.

text: My father had a heart attack last year but today he only has a mild cold with a runny nose.
rationale: History of a past heart attack is not an emergency now; the current illness is mild.

text: Mujhe subah se halka sa sir dard hai, aur koi problem nahi.
rationale: (Hinglish) Mild headache only: self-care.
